reason: Misdescribed the immigration hearings he opposed (profile review, 2026-10-07)

overview.text: On foreign policy, he is a member of the pro-Israel lobby AIPAC and introduced a 2019 House resolution condemning the Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions movement targeting Israel. He co-chairs the bipartisan Abraham Accords Caucus. He opposed 'mega master' immigration court hearings that group many cases together, arguing they undermine due process for asylum seekers. He says his office returned more than $5 million to constituents in 2026 by resolving issues with federal agencies like the IRS and the Department of Veterans Affairs. In his 2022 campaign, he said he helped pass the American Rescue Plan and the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act.
